products.description: The final step in Orveda’s Prep and Post procedure protocol is the Regenesome™ Mineral Shield SPF 50 : a 100% mineral-based sunscreen, designed to protect skin from sun exposure ahead of, in between, and following procedures. Our Mineral Shield is an SPF50 high protection, 100% mineral sunscreen, specifically formulated to protect skin from sun exposure both before and after the procedure.
